messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-12345 - us-east-az2 serving-latency spike (threshold 95p > 800ms)

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 created · Severity: P1 · Services: inference-api-hosted · Assigned: ben_oncall

alice_ops: seeing 5xx and latency spikes across multiple routes to us-east-az2, not just a single model. dashboards show token backlog rising.

ben_oncall: acked on pagerduty. joining. any customer-facing impact yet? :eyes:

carla_sre: preliminary impact: ~4.8% of live requests getting 502/504 or >2s tail latency since 1698450900. errors concentrated on short-seq gen jobs.

ben_oncall: thanks. tagging network to check for NIC or fabric issues @dave_network

alice_ops: logs show heavy KV-cache evictions around 1698450800, followed by per-host cpu steal increasing. probable mem pressure -> slow io.

carla_sre: rolling through runbook: "region-capacity-imbalance". steps: 1) divert new traffic off az2, 2) scale dedicated pool in other AZs, 3) force kvcache reload.

ben_oncall: doing traffic divert now (will use staged rollouts).

ben_oncall: ```
# command
redwoodctl routing divert --region us-east --from az2 --to az1,az3 --pct 100 --reason "az2 serving-latency spike"
```

incident-bot: Routing change initiated: divert rule created id=divert-9243 · ETA propagation ~30s

alice_ops: divert propagated to edge in ~18s. monitoring now.

dave_network: checked fabric and BGP neighbors for az2 cluster - no link flaps in the last hour. NIC errors are low. I'm seeing increased retransmits to storage endpoints from az2 hosts. filing ticket to infra-storage.

carla_sre: scaling dedicated inference pool in az1 and az3 by +3 GPUs each to absorb traffic. triggering autoscale override.

ben_oncall: override commands: ```
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool dedicated-us-east-az1 --add-gpus 3
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool dedicated-us-east-az3 --add-gpus 3
```

incident-bot: Capacity scale requests accepted. Jobs enqueued. estimated ready in 120s

emily_support: logged customer impact in status page draft: "Partial degradation in us-east (az2) - some requests may see errors or high latency. Engineers are working on mitigation." please confirm wording.

ben_oncall: looks good, add "no data loss, requests being diverted" and link to PD incident. publish once we see divert stable for 2m.

carla_sre: after divert + scale, error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.9% in 90s. tail latency trending down. KV-cache pressure linearly decreasing but still elevated.

dave_network: storage team confirmed a transient IO saturation on az2-attached volumes between 1698450700-1698451000; they throttled some back-end jobs and capacity reclaimed.

ben_oncall: good signal. can we start controlled reconnect of some traffic to az2? want to avoid oscillation.

carla_sre: recommended: gradual ramp, 10% back to az2 for next 5m, watch errors/latency, then 25%, then full if healthy.

ben_oncall: applying staged ramp: ```
redwoodctl routing divert-adjust --divert-id divert-9243 --to-az2-pct 10
```

incident-bot: Routing adjustment applied. new weights: az1 45%, az3 45%, az2 10%

alice_ops: metrics: errors stable at ~0.8%, az2 tail latency back to baseline at 10% load. proceeding to 30% in 5m if stable.

carla_sre: also cleared kvcache on az2 hosts to force warm reloads, reduced eviction churn. command used: ```
for host in $(redwoodctl list-hosts --az az2); do ssh $host 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-kvcache'; done
```

dave_network: storage throttle fully cleared by infra team. no more abnormal retransmits.

ben_oncall: good. i'll update PD with status and prepare to resolve when we reach 10m stable. emily, please publish status update now.

emily_support: publishing status update with incident link https://status.redwood.in/incident/PD-12345 and PD link https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12345 · message notes divert+scale mitigations and customer guidance. :white_check_mark:

carla_sre: monitoring for 10m window. if stable, we'll remove divert and scale down temporary gpus after health confirms. also preparing RCA notes: primary cause - backend storage IO saturation in az2 leading to kvcache churn and serving latency. follow-ups: storage throttling safeguards, autoscaler policy tweak to pre-warm caches when divert triggers.

ben_oncall: resolving PD incident after 15m stable checkpoint. I'll hand to postmortem. thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 marked resolved by ben_oncall (duration 00:12:46)

emily_support: final status update published: "Incident resolved, root cause and next steps being investigated. No customer data loss."
summary: PD-12345 us-east-az2 serving-latency spike -> divert+scale mitigation; IO saturation on az2 storage caused KV-cache evictions and tail latency. incident resolved after diversion and capacity scaling.
